app.description: See where you are heading, where you are now, and what to do next.

home.body: The Path home arrives in the next milestone. This build proves the foundations underneath it.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.body: Pages you have opened before still work. Reconnect to load this one.

styleguide.title: Styleguide
styleguide.intro: Calm and minimal, with one focal element per screen. Every screen in the app is built from these.

usage.soft: Quiet fills: active tab, pills, notes.
usage.accent: The only accent: sage. The primary action, with dark text. Nothing else.
usage.track: The unfinished part of the stage line.

type.bodySample: Everything in the app supports or guides you on your path: your goal, your stages, your log and your coach.
type.labelLabel: Label: JetBrains Mono, the only uppercase

shape.radius: Corners are soft: 12 px on buttons and inputs, 16 px on cards.
shape.dividers: Groups are separated by space or one hairline. No dotted rules.
shape.space: An 8 pt grid, with at least 24 px of padding at the screen edge.
shape.elevation: Cards sit on a hairline and a faint shadow. No heavy black blocks.
shape.motion: Motion is short ({duration} ms) and switches off when reduced motion is requested.
shape.targets: Touch targets are at least 44 px.

components.togglePainHint: Health data. Off unless you turn it on

stageTrack.label: Stages towards your goal
stageTrack.daysLeft: {count, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}

chart.title: Weekly load
chart.note: One thin line on hairline rules. A sage dot marks the current week.

cover.why: By {date}. Because I want to race the Zurich 10K with my club.
cover.nextMeta: {count} spots left · Uses Regular season pass

icons.intro: Our own set. One round line on a 24 px grid, always in the colour of the text beside it, never the accent.

photos.intro: Twelve photos are the only imagery in the app. One photo per screen at most, always muted, and never with text on a busy area: text sits below the picture or on a soft fade.
photos.cardLabel: Class card: photo on top, text below
photos.heroLabel: Hero: fades into the page, goal sits underneath
photos.textureLabel: Texture: a quiet background for empty states
photos.emptyBody: Sessions you book show up here.
